headline: NCLT Notice of Hearing: Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Oilmax Energy Private Limited into Asian Energy Services Limited
sum: Asian Energy Services Limited filed a scheme of merger by absorption to merge its subsidiary or affiliate Oilmax Energy Private Limited, with a National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Mumbai Bench hearing scheduled for 7 August 2026 for scheme sanction.
detail: Asian Energy Services Limited, a listed company, initiated a merger petition before the NCLT Mumbai Bench for approval of a scheme of merger by absorption whereby Oilmax Energy Private Limited would be merged into and absorbed by the acquirer. The NCLT scheduled a hearing for 7 August 2026 to consider sanction of the scheme. The company published a statutory notice in newspapers (as directed by the NCLT) to inform shareholders and creditors. No merger consideration, exchange ratio, or integration timelines are disclosed in the public notice.
